name: EPIC 212452424

text.card: A red giant 5,736 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.72 solar masses and 14.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,811 K at its surface.
